questions.question: How did the people respond to God's word in chapter 43?
options: They crowned for themselves a new king and rebuilt the whole city
They humbly obeyed the word and remained together in the land
They accused Jeremiah of lying and went to Egypt anyway
They put Jeremiah cruelly to death because of all of his words
questions.answer: They accused Jeremiah of lying and went to Egypt anyway

questions.question: What sign did Jeremiah perform in Egypt in chapter 43?
options: Buried a linen belt away to show forth their coming ruin and shame
Hid large stones to show Nebuchadnezzar would set his throne there
Wore a heavy yoke upon him to show their coming servitude
Broke a clay jar to pieces to show the city's coming destruction
questions.answer: Hid large stones to show Nebuchadnezzar would set his throne there

questions.question: The people took Jeremiah and Baruch with them to Egypt against God's command.
They came to the land of _____ and did not obey the voice of the LORD.
Nebuchadnezzar would come and set his _____ above these hidden stones.
